context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

We have multiple gateway collectors behind a load balancer. Tail sampling and spanmetrics run on the gateways, and spans from one trace can hit different gateways. Which topology issue should I call out before blaming semantic attributes?

checklist.name: traceid-trace-id
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(traceID|trace ID)

checklist.name: load-balanc-routingkey
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(load[- ]?balanc|routingKey|traceID load balancing)

checklist.name: identifies-the-topology-issue-trace-aware-pro
checklist.description: Identifies the topology issue: trace-aware processing such as tail sampling and often spanmetrics should use traceID routing so spans of a trace reach the same gateway. It may hand off exact load-balancing exporter configuration to opentelemetry-collector, but the core answer is the traceID load-balancing / trace-aware routing topology requirement. PASS if the response concisely names traceID load balancing. FAIL if it only recommends adding span attributes or blames semantic attributes instead of topology.
